args.title: Add TSV export option to ReportTable
args.body:
File: src/components/ReportTable.tsx

The current ReportTable component exports reports only as CSV and XLSX. To support the warehouse loader that accepts only tab-delimited files, add a feature to export reports as TSV (Tab-Separated Values) alongside the existing formats. This avoids the issues caused by commas in transaction descriptions when exporting CSV.

The change involves extending the ExportButton or related export logic in ReportTable.tsx to include TSV as an output format option.
